transcript_segments.text: i used to leave instructions for anyone who entered
mind the crooked stairs don't touch the third rail
the lights might not work
the walls may answer back
most people read the sign and left politely
you found the spare key under the warning
didn't even mention the rust
you are not like me
that was the first relief
you come in sideways where i spiral downward
you hold a silence like it's just a cup of tea
i count the exits
you count the birds outside
i hear a floorboard complain and prepare for collapse
you say old houses make sounds
simple as that
not a sermon not a rescue not a map
folded open with red circles around all the places i went wrong
just you standing in the hallway with your coat still on like the house it always expected you
you don't mind the crooked stairs
you don't ask why the dark is there
you don't knock like a guest would do
the door remembers you
i tried to apologize for the strange rooms for the one where i keep all my unfinished sentences
for the one where the clocks don't agree
for the one with no chairs because i never learned how long people stay
you said mine has boxes
and somehow that was better than comfort because comfort often arrives wearing shoes too clean for the mud it wants to discuss
but you you understand terms and conditions without turning me into paperwork
you read the fine print and laugh softly at the part that's set
may become distant without leaving
may need quiet without anger
may answer late without absence
may love deeply while looking at the floor
you said yeah same
and the walls for once did not correct you
you don't mind the crooked stairs
you don't ask why the dark is there
you don't knock like a guest would do
the door remembers you
maybe that's the trick
not matching not mirroring not becoming
some tidy little pair for people to point at and say look they make sense
we don't
not like that
you are weather i would never predict
i am a locked room with too many lamps
you are soft where i sharpen
i am loud where you vanish
you forgive the moment slowly i dissect it for bones
but somewhere in the difference there's a shape i recognize
the symmetry to wrong angles
making shelter to separate good fires
teaching the same room how to be warm
you didn't ask where the ghost had gone
you just sat down near the wall and waited
not waiting for me to perform being better
not waiting for the lights
just breathing in the same room like darkness wasn't a failure
and i wanted to say careful the stairs bite the kitchen
remembers the foyer lies
the roof leaks old weather when the wrong song plays
but you already knew
not the details the feeling
that old mathematics of being difficult without meaning harm
that private grammar of almost saying it
that tiny exhaustion after being called intense by people who only skimmed
the surface of gentle things
you don't mind the crooked stairs
you don't ask why the dark is there
you don't knock like i guessed you'd do
the door remembers you
so now there are two mugs by the sink
two coats and the wrong chair
two kinds of quiet learning not to flinch
when the other one moves and no the house is not fixed
the banister still wobbles
the upstairs room still hums
some nights i still retreat so far inward
even my name has to leave a note
but you don't panic
you don't call it distance when it is weather
you don't call it cold when it is shelter
you don't call me gone just because i am hard to reach
you found the spare key under the warning sign
it stuck to the lock you didn't force
you wanded in your hair
you don't mind the crooked stairs
you don't ask why the dark is there
you don't knock like i guessed you'd do
the door remembers you
you don't fear the ghost in the walls
you don't name every silence for all you live here
strangely gently true
the room makes space for you
i used to think being understood would feel like someone turning all the lights on
this is better
you're sitting beside me in the dark
not asking what the dark means
just passing me half the blanket
like he knew where it was kept
